```python
import pygame
import sys
import time
import random

pygame.init()

# Set up the display
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 600
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("Basic Pygame Project")

# Set up the font
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

# Set up the clock
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# Set up the colors
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

# Set up the game variables
player_x = WIDTH // 2
player_y = HEIGHT // 2
player_velocity_x = 0
player_velocity_y = 0

enemy_x = random.randint(0, WIDTH)
enemy_y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT)
enemy_velocity_x = random.randint(-5, 5)
enemy_velocity_y = random.randint(-5, 5)

def draw_text(text, color, x, y):
    text_surface = font.render(text, True, color)
    screen.blit(text_surface, (x, y))

# Game loop
running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
            pygame.quit()
            sys.exit()

        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT:
                player_velocity_x = -5
            elif event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
                player_velocity_x = 5
            elif event.key == pygame.K_UP:
                player_velocity_y = -5
            elif event.key == pygame.K_DOWN:
                player_velocity_y = 5
            elif event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
                running = False

        if event.type == pygame.KEYUP:
            if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT or event.key == pygame.K_RIGHT:
                player_velocity_x = 0
            elif event.key == pygame.K_UP or event.key == pygame.K_DOWN:
                player_velocity_y = 0

    screen.fill(BLACK)

    player_x += player_velocity_x
    player_y += player_velocity_y

    enemy_x += enemy_velocity_x
    enemy_y += enemy_velocity_y

    if enemy_x <= 0 or enemy_x >= WIDTH:
        enemy_velocity_x *= -1
    if enemy_y <= 0 or enemy_y >= HEIGHT:
        enemy_velocity_y *= -1

    screen.blit(pygame.image.load("player.png"), (player_x, player_y))
    screen.blit(pygame.image.load("enemy.png"), (enemy_x, enemy_y))

    draw_text(f"FPS: {int(clock.get_fps())}", WHITE, 10, 10)

    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

```
